scope: CICM 2021--2025 official Springer proceedings plus citable CICM workshop proceedings in the same window when an official CEUR or proceedings record is available
claim_boundary: This finite record documents the stated bibliographic screen used for the related-work table. It is not a proof that no unqueried database, later metadata update, uncitable page, or differently phrased paper exists.

screen_conclusion: For the included source sets, query strings, interface terms, and exclusion categories above, the closest retained rows are the included_hits. Therefore the manuscript may state only that no closer item was found by this stated screen.
